How To Register To Vote
Looking for your Voter Registration status?  Click
here
to find out.
How To Register To Vote
Qualifications
To register to vote in the City of Springfield you must:
Be a citizen of the United States
Be a resident of Springfield
Be 18 years of age or older on or before Election Day
You may request a Voter Registration Form by calling the Election Commission at (413)787-6190.  Or you can download a Mail-In Voter Registration Form by clicking this
link
.
Where To Register
You may come in and fill out a Voter Registration Form in person at the Springfield Board of Elections.
You can also register in person at the Secretary of State's office at 436 Dwight Street, Room 102.
At any Massachusetts social service agency (including but not limited to) the Department of Transitional Assistance offices, Mass Rehab offices, & the Department of Mental Health offices.
If you would like to register to vote online you may do so by following this
link
You can also download and print the
National Voter Registration Application
or you can download a Massachusetts Mail-In Voter Registration Form by clicking this
link.
The Voter Registration Form is available in English and Spanish.  Or you may obtain a mail-in Voter Registration Form from the Election Office. Fill it out completely and sign at the bottom; otherwise it will be rejected and sent back to the applicant.  Make sure the mail-in Registration Form has an original signature.  Mail
(DO NOT FAX)
the Voter Registration Form to:
Springfield Election Commission
City Hall, Room 8
36 Court Street
Springfield, MA 01103
